messages:
sara_support: FYI customer AcmeRenew reports two invoices/charges after renewal. They received INV-2026-5503 and INV-2026-5504 and bank shows two settlements. Bank txn id: STRP_txn_1A2B3. Customer says one was from their PO and one was an immediate card charge. Need reversal and a clear customer note.

james_support: Ack. Can you drop the invoice IDs and any logs? Do we have any webhook retry noise? @naveen_billing can you take point?

naveen_billing: On it. Quick summary from billing logs: we got `invoice.created` for INV-2026-5503 (PO path) then ~45s later payments worker processed a card capture that created INV-2026-5504. Both responded `200` to the gateway. Looks like PO flow set subscription state to PENDING but the manual card capture path didn't check that flag. Repro steps I used:
```
1) create subscription with `purchase_order` meta
2) webhook: `invoice.created` -> creates invoice with `status: pending`
3) frontend manual capture triggers `POST /payments/settle` without idempotency_key -> creates second invoice/capture
```
I'll attach event ids in a sec.

lisa_engineer: Thanks. Paste the event ids and webhook ids so I can grep the worker logs. Also note: the PO invoice had VAT=0% (customer exempt) but the card capture invoice included VAT lines — that's why customer saw different amounts. We should avoid double charging VAT refunds.

naveen_billing: Event ids: `evt_01POABC` (PO path), `evt_01CARDXYZ` (card capture). Webhook ids: `wh_8234` (sent twice — retry), `wh_8234_retry` (gateway resent). Root cause appears to be missing `idempotency_key` for PO approval route. Patch branch: `hotfix/payments-idempotency`.

sara_support: @refund-bot please queue an immediate refund for the duplicate card charge INV-2026-5504 (STRP_txn_1A2B3). Customer needs confirmation and a credit note PDF. Mark as high priority. :warning:

refund-bot: Refund job queued: `job_9987`. Processing refund to Stripe txn STRP_txn_1A2B3. ETA ~15m. Notifying finance for VAT/ledger handling.

michael_finance: Confirmed we'll process the reversal but we need manager signoff for >$50k. Kicking emergency approval now. Also generating interim credit note for the customer: https://redwood.internal/credits/INV-2026-5504-note (internal).

lisa_engineer: I kicked a canary deploy with the idempotency fix to catch duplicates in payments-worker. Deploy command: `./scripts/deploy payments-worker hotfix/payments-idempotency --env=prod-canary`. Smoke logs show: `duplicate detected: evt_01CARDXYZ ignored` and `idempotency_key set for PO-approval`

naveen_billing: Refund completed at 1722223500, ledger updated, credit note attached to customer account, finance approval recorded (mgr_approval_452). Customer notified that the duplicate charge has been refunded and VAT corrected. Closing loop unless customer reopens.

sara_support: Thanks team — please add a short postmortem note to #postmortems and a quick runbook step to prevent PO+card double capture (add explicit check on subscription state before capture). :white_check_mark:
